description: This file contains the implementation of the Customer controller class within the admin controller namespace of an OpenCart project. It manages customer listing, filtering, and related operations in the admin panel.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class handling customer management in the admin panel of OpenCart, including listing, filtering, and customer actions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method for displaying the customer list page, processing filters and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the listing endpoint, responds with customer list for AJAX or API calls.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Constructs and returns the HTML view of the customer list based on current filters and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares and displays the customer form for add/edit operations, including setting up data such as store options, customer groups, filters, and existing customer info.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving of customer data, handling validation and persistence.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Handles unlocking or resetting customer login attempts.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected customer records.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles customer login logic via token creation and redirection.

methods.name: payment
methods.description: Displays customer payment methods and subscriptions, supports pagination and viewing details.

methods.name: getPayment
methods.description: Retrieves payment methods and subscription details for a specific customer.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads language, models, views, and controllers essential to the class operations.

methods.name: deletePayment
methods.description: Deletes a specific payment record associated with a customer.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the customer history log including comments and date entries.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves customer history entries with pagination details.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new history comment or entry for a customer.

methods.name: transaction
methods.description: Displays customer transactions with pagination, including amounts, descriptions, and dates.

methods.name: getTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for a customer with details such as amount and description.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a new transaction record for a customer.

methods.name: reward
methods.description: Displays the customer's reward points, total rewards, and related pagination.

methods.name: getReward
methods.description: Retrieves reward points and total reward balance for a customer.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Adds reward points to a customer's account.

methods.name: ip
methods.description: Retrieves and displays IP addresses associated with a customer, with pagination and store info.

methods.name: getIp
methods.description: Gets the client's IP address, filters by customer ID, with support for pagination and store info integration.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Retrieves authorization tokens and details related to customer authorizations, with permission checks.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Handles authorization logic, returning authorization details or tokens.

methods.name: deleteAuthorize
methods.description: Deletes a specific authorization record, involves permission checks and JSON response.
